svg.aria-label: uv sync: Install runtime + dev dependencies from uv.lock. uv run python scripts/fetch_model.py: Both backends, pinned + SHA-256 verified (~1.5 GB). Or one: fetch_model.py siglip or fetch_model.py mobilenet. uv run uvicorn synthwerk_vision.main:create_app --factory --reload: Start the API. Open http://localhost:8000/docs. curl -F "image=@hut.jpg" http://localhost:8000/v1/classifications: Classify one image
